rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Organized Insurance Claims Fraud")`
`comment("Detects shared enablers and inception-proximate claims indicating organized ring")`
index=flame_insurance sourcetype=flame:claims_management
  (claim_type="motor" OR claim_type="medical" OR claim_type="personal_injury")
| eval days_from_inception = round((strptime(claim_date, "%Y-%m-%d") - strptime(policy_inception_date, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400, 0)
| eval inception_flag = if(days_from_inception <= 90 AND (claim_severity="high" OR claim_severity="total_loss"), 1, 0)
| stats dc(claim_id) AS claim_count,
        sum(claim_amount) AS total_claimed,
        dc(claimant_id) AS unique_claimants,
        dc(policy_id) AS unique_policies,
        values(claimant_name) AS claimants,
        values(claim_type) AS claim_types,
        avg(days_from_inception) AS avg_days_from_inception,
        sum(inception_flag) AS inception_proximate_claims
  BY provider_id, provider_name, legal_representative_id
| where claim_count >= 2
| eval risk_score = case(
    claim_count >= 5 AND inception_proximate_claims >= 2, "critical",
    claim_count >= 3 AND unique_claimants >= 3, "high",
    inception_proximate_claims >= 1, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table provider_id, provider_name, legal_representative_id,
        claim_count, total_claimed, unique_claimants, unique_policies,
        claim_types, avg_days_from_inception, inception_proximate_claims, risk_score
| sort - claim_count
rules.title: DL-0175: Organized Insurance Claims Fraud — Shared Professional Enablers and Claim Timing Clustering Around Policy Inception (SPLUNK)
